== Notes ==
* This is an [[ArenaNet]] developer skill used in testing. It is not a usable skill on the live servers.
* The [[skill icon]] is that of a generic skill's with "D3v H@X" (Dev Hax) and "RiP Troggy" superimposed on it.
* BAMPH! does 999 [[damage]] when it [[target]]s a [[foe]]. If it targets self it gives a [[speed boost]], extra [[health]] and [[energy]] regeneration and you can't be slowed down (source: [[User talk:Isaiah Cartwright/Izzy Talk Archive 8#Dev Only Skills|Izzy talk]]).
* There are several variations of this skill such as a lite version and delayed version.
* See BAMPH! in action [https://me.ign.com/en/guild-wars-eye-of-the-north/35229/official-demo-overview-hd in this IGN demo of EotN] at around 4:20 and 7:40.

== Trivia ==
* "RIP Troggy" refers to [[W:Trogdor|Trogdor]], who used to be the icon for this skill.
* The name likely refers to "BAMF", which stands for "Bad-Ass Mother Fucker".
